content.short: Jasper Vault is a peer-to-peer interoperable options protocol.
content.description: Jasper Vault aims to transform the DeFi options space by making trading simpler, safer, and more efficient. By applying Account Abstraction (AA) technology on Arbitrum and Solana, and Hash Time-Lock Contract (HTLC) on the Bitcoin network, the project enables peer-to-peer trading and wallet interoperability across different chains. This cross-chain capability expands access for users across networks, fostering direct interactions between wallets on separate ecosystems.
